fullContent:
Shleshma Gajankusham 
 Reference: Rasa Yoga Ratnakara 
 It is an ancient classical formulation used for various kaphaj diseases. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified Sulphur 
 Purified Mercury 
 Iron bhasma 
 Cardamom 
 Cloves 
 Cinnamon 
 Trikatu (Zingiber officinalis, Long pepper, Black pepper) 
 Triphala (Emblica officinalis, Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellirica) 
 
 Dosage 
 10 grams in 25 doses. It can be taken with solutions of honey, candy, ginger juice. 
 Indications 
 
 Kapha aggravated diseases 
 Voice disorders 
 Respiratory disorders 
 Inflammatory diseases 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage might cause severe complications. 
 Self-medications is discouraged. 
 It is better avoided or taken under strict medical supervision during pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
